pages.title: Purpose of These Notes
pages.text: A little $(item)Draconium$() leads from simple crystals to vault-sized storage, Fusion Crafting, and extraordinary tools. These pages preserve the details most likely to cost time—or blocks—during experimentation.$(br2)A gentle route is crystal networks, Energy Core storage, Fusion, then equipment and modules.

pages.title: Read the Machine Too
pages.text: These notes explain construction and observed behavior; ordinary recipes appear on the relevant pages. For live values, open the machine or crystal itself and trust its current screen over an old number in any book.$(br2)Draconic Evolution measures energy in OP, which interoperates with compatible energy systems.
